verses.text: I find rest in God; only he can save me.
He is my rock and my salvation. He is my defender; I will not be defeated.
How long will you attack someone? Will all of you kill that person? Who is like a leaning wall, like a fence ready to fall?
They are planning to make that person fall. They enjoy telling lies. With their mouths they bless, but in their hearts they curse. Selah
I find rest in God; only he gives me hope.
He is my rock and my salvation. He is my defender; I will not be defeated.
My honor and salvation come from God. He is my mighty rock and my protection.
People, trust God all the time. Tell him all your problems, because God is our protection. Selah
The least of people are only a breath, and even the greatest are just a lie. On the scales, they weigh nothing; together they are only a breath.
Do not trust in force. Stealing is of no use. Even if you gain more riches, don’t put your trust in them.
God has said this, and I have heard it over and over: God is strong.
The Lord is loving. You reward people for what they have done.
